title: ononis cephalotes var. montana
intro: Ononis cephalotes var. montana, commonly known as Mountain Restharrow, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, specifically a subalpine perennial herb native to the European Alps. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of gastrointestinal issues, skin infections, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Restharrow include its ability to protect the gastrointestinal tract, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
